meta.description: Report lost items, post things you've found, and let AI help reunite people with their things.

landing.heroSubtitle: Algeria's lost and found registry. Report in two minutes, and let us do the looking.
landing.searchPlaceholder: What are you looking for? e.g. black wallet
landing.step1Body: A two-minute form for what you lost — or what you found.
landing.step2Body: Every new report is compared against the other side. You get notified.
landing.step3Body: Answer the owner's question, confirm the match, arrange the handover.

browse.lostDescription: Things people are looking for. Recognise something? Open it and get in touch.
browse.foundDescription: Things waiting to be claimed. Lost something? It might already be here.

claims.messagePlaceholder: Briefly say why you think it's yours.
claims.contactBody: You can now contact each other directly.
claims.rejectedBody: The reporter didn't recognise your answers.

report.step0Hint: This determines which side we search.

report.step4Hint: One last look before it goes live.
